name: Classic Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Boil water and cook pasta according to package directions.
Sauté chopped garlic and onion in olive oil.
Add canned tomatoes and fresh basil. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Toss the cooked pasta in the sauce and top with Parmesan cheese.

name: Quick Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables into strips.
Stir fry chicken in sesame oil until cooked.
Add vegetables, ginger, and soy sauce. Cook for 5 minutes.
Serve hot over a bed of white rice.

name: Simple Lentil Soup
instructions: Chop vegetables (carrot, celery, onion).
Sauté them with garlic and cumin in a pot.
Add lentils and broth, bring to boil.
Simmer for 30 minutes until lentils are tender. Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa
instructions: Brown the ground beef and drain fat.
Add taco seasoning and a little water; simmer.
Warm tortillas.
Serve beef in tortillas with chopped tomato, onion, lettuce, and cheese.

name: Avocado Toast with Egg
instructions: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with salt and pepper.
Fry the egg sunny-side up.
Spread avocado on toast, top with egg and red pepper flakes.

name: Salmon with Roasted Asparagus
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss asparagus with olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Season salmon with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Roast salmon and asparagus for 12-15 minutes.

name: Mushroom and Spinach Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs and milk.
Sauté mushrooms and spinach in butter.
Pour egg mixture over vegetables, sprinkle with cheese.
Cook until set, fold and serve.

name: Chicken Curry with Coconut Milk
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger.
Add chicken and cook until browned.
Stir in curry powder and coconut milk; simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve hot with rice.

name: Homemade Pizza Margherita
instructions: Preheat oven. Roll out pizza dough.
Spread tomato sauce and top with sliced mozzarella.
Bake for 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Black Bean Burgers
instructions: Mash black beans.
Mix with bread crumbs, onion, garlic, and chili powder.
Form into patties and bake or fry until heated through.
Serve on buns with toppings.

name: Creamy Tomato Soup
instructions: Sauté onion in butter.
Add canned tomatoes and vegetable broth.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and fresh basil before serving.

name: Pork Chops with Apple Sauce
instructions: Season pork chops with salt and pepper.
Sear pork chops in butter.
Dice apples and simmer with cinnamon and sugar to make sauce.
Serve chops with apple sauce.

name: Hummus and Veggie Wrap
instructions: Spread hummus evenly onto tortillas.
Layer with spinach, sliced cucumber, carrot, and bell pepper.
Roll up tightly and slice in half.

name: Baked Potato with Chili
instructions: Bake the potato until soft (about 60 min).
Heat the chili.
Split the potato, add butter and chili.
Top with cheese and a dollop of sour cream.

name: Garlic Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Cook pasta.
Sauté garlic in butter, add shrimp and cook until pink.
Deglaze with white wine and lemon juice.
Toss shrimp and sauce with pasta and parsley.

name: Tofu Scramble with Turmeric
instructions: Crumble tofu.
Sauté onion and bell pepper.
Add tofu, turmeric, and nutritional yeast; cook until heated.
Stir in spinach and serve.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Combine broth, chopped chicken, carrot, celery, and onion in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then simmer until vegetables are tender.
Add egg noodles and cook until done.

name: Pancake Stack with Berries
instructions: Mix flour, milk, egg, sugar, and baking powder.
Pour batter onto a buttered griddle.
Cook until bubbles form, flip, and cook other side.
Stack pancakes and top with berries.

name: Cobb Salad
instructions: Chop lettuce and arrange on a platter.
Arrange diced chicken, boiled egg, crumbled bacon, avocado, tomato, and blue cheese on top.
Serve with vinaigrette dressing.

name: Spicy Peanut Noodles
instructions: Cook egg noodles.
Whisk together peanut butter, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and chili oil.
Toss noodles with the peanut sauce.
Garnish with chopped scallions.
